description: Simulates what selling shares of a wager would return, without selling anything: returns {amount, shares, price} for the user's wager. Production values the position from the current order-book bids; it can return an amount of 0 on the first call for a market while its book cache warms up, so call it again before believing a 0. Run this and show the result to the user before sell_bet. Pass the wager id, not a market id.

id.description: Wager id, as returned by get_user_bets (field `id`). This is not a market id or an event id.

shares.description: Number of shares to simulate selling; must not exceed the shares held in the wager. Omit to simulate selling the entire position.

name: get_partial_sell_amount
title: Simulate selling shares
